messages.subject: Acustica data comparison
parts:
Hi all,
I just started working with acoustic data on killer whales in R, I'm a beginner in this field.
What's the best way to compare 2 sounds seeking similarity? Should I compare oscillograms or rather spectrograms?

Ant advice is appreciated,
Thanks,
Stefano

messages.author: b83ca0eafa6de755
messages.subject: Re: Acustica data comparison
parts:
Hi Stephano

Spectograms would be the way to go. You can look into machine-learning algorithms to group similar calls based on spectograms. For a basic and more manual approach, I would recommend using Audacity (free) to analyse the calls. You could also look into the many bioaccoustic programs that are also free (such as Raven), although Audacity generally gives you more options as it is designed for sound in general.
